body:
## What it does

A Japanese-language walkthrough for requesting a company's full historical registration record through the Kantan Touki online service. It guides you from filling in the application to settling the fee by Pay-easy and then waiting on delivery by post. You keep control of your own login and banking throughout. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @sat0xshi shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
